reason: Honestly I'd download it the day I saw it and build like four apps on the free tier, but that's my pattern with every productivity app: by week two I'm back in my notes app and the budgeting app I already pay for. Five apps and 50 actions is plenty for my one-week honeymoon, so I'd never hit the paywall.
objection: I already pay for a budgeting app that works and has my bank linked, so moving my money stuff into something new feels like a downgrade, and I don't trust myself to still be using Quilt in a month.
would_change_my_mind: If I was still opening it every day after a month because the purchase-to-budget thing actually replaced my budgeting app, so I could cancel that and pay for this instead.
